shipped.what: the shipped ranking (search graph) on the graph without the entities step

entities.what: the ranking after plan kg-zip-to-answers step 3 (a matched entity brings its source documents) on the multi-hop strategy's graph, entities step included, walk left out

cost.what: the answers of the entities step in the graphs' memo, every build of them (a run calls no model)

extraction.priced_by: the cost Claude Code reported, else the mapping's price

compare_holdout.command: kg bench compare musique-shipped.json musique-entities.json --split holdout
text: set            metric          n  before   after     diff      se  ci95

multi-hop.what: the same ranking and graph with the strategy's walk added back by --settings

cost.what: the answers of the entities step in the graphs' memo, every build of them (a run calls no model)

extraction.priced_by: the cost Claude Code reported, else the mapping's price

compare_holdout.command: kg bench compare musique-shipped.json musique-multi-hop.json --split holdout
text: set            metric          n  before   after     diff      se  ci95

note: MuSiQue (7,921 documents, 301 tune and 158 holdout questions), rerun for plan kg-zip-to-answers step 3 at evo-ak 0.57.0 (b419a087), extractor 64865e69101ecc1a. The entity graph of plan kg-entity-graph (bench/results/entity-graph.json) was built again from its memo, copied from the cache of extractor 60d929518ab300b9: every entities answer came from the memo, no model was called. Before the fix the entities arm read 0.0498 tune and 0.0570 holdout (entity-graph.json); after it, an entity the question matches gives its rank to up to three documents that mention it. The multi-hop arm is unchanged: its walk already listed entities after documents. A tune-only variant that left the documents the search ranked in their own place and brought only the others read 0.0399 and was dropped; holdout was not read for it.
